heading: Five commitments guide every Tuesday.
intro: This isn't a lecture or a quick fix. It's a community built on a few things we take seriously.

items.title: Safety
items.text: A place where men are loved and accepted as they are, not as they pretend to be.

items.title: Healing
items.text: Helping men meet God in the middle of their struggle, not after they've cleaned it up.

items.title: Honesty
items.text: Building an authentic life with nothing left to hide.

items.title: Education
items.text: Learning how recovery works and getting tools you can use immediately.

items.title: Accountability
items.text: Men who walk with you, keep you honest, and hold out real hope for purity.
